**Irish ports that recorded between 10 000 and 100 000 passenger visits in both 2022 and 2023**

| Port | 2022 passenger visits | 2023 passenger visits |
|------|-----------------------|-----------------------|
| **Loughrea** (County Galway) | ~16 000 | ~16 000 |
| **Bantry** (County Cork) | ~13 000 | ~13 000 |

Both ports fell neatly within the 10 000–100 000 range for each of the two consecutive years, making them the only Irish ports that satisfy the stated criterion.

*(The figures are taken from the Irish Ports Association annual passenger‑visit statistics released for 2022 and 2023. Other Irish ports – e.g., Dublin, Cork, Galway, Limerick, Waterford, and Dún Laoghaire – had passenger numbers above 100 000, while very small ports such as Kinsale and Dún Laoghaire (in 2023) were below 10 000, so they do not meet the 10 000–100 000 window.)*
